description: Generate a MiniMax H3 video from 1 to 9 required reference images.

fields.name: videoTime
fields.description: Video duration in seconds. Supported values: 5, 10, 15.

fields.name: prompt
fields.description: Video generation prompt describing motion, subject consistency, camera movement, and the ecommerce scene. Maximum 2000 characters.
fields.example: Keep the product consistent while the camera slowly orbits and highlights material details.

fields.name: promptOptimizer
fields.description: Whether Nexscope should optimize the video prompt before generation. Defaults to false.

fields.name: isPro
fields.description: Whether to use the model's professional generation mode when supported. Defaults to false.

fields.name: imageList
fields.description: Public reference image URLs. Provide 1 to 9 images.

fields.name: aspectRatio
fields.description: Target video aspect ratio supported by this model. Supported values: adaptive, 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9.

example.prompt: Keep the product consistent while the camera slowly orbits and highlights material details.
